verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state core operations (.remember, .recall, .improve, .forget) and dataset/session management are accessible via Python, CLI, REST API, and MCP, not just the Web UI (cognee-docs-42, -5, -22). However, the OpenAPI/REST API spec could not be located by direct probing (cognee-probe-2 returned 404s across all standard endpoints), and there is no explicit confirmation that UI-only features like graph visualization/exploration have a fully equivalent API surface. Missing for 10: a discoverable/published OpenAPI schema confirming full REST parity, and explicit mapping of every UI action (e.g., visual graph exploration) to an API call.
